answer: A registration deposit that unlocks only after attested work across several epochs brakes Sybil attacks. Each new identity locks capital before voting, and stake returns only once peers confirm real activity. A farm of ten thousand keys needs ten thousand deposits at once, with no recycling, since each key waits out its own vesting window and pays rent meanwhile. Detected farms are slashed together, so one link burns the cluster, a mirror of the attacker's strategy. Honest miners recoup the deposit, while the attacker has no zephyr of free accounts, only a costly forge.
